title: JDIThread#getTopStackFrame() performance
description:
The current implementation of JDIThread#getTopStackFrame() calls
computeStackFrames() to update the stack frame list if needed.

computeStackFrames() is not a trivial method, it retrieve all stack frames and
can be expensive (ReferenceTypeImpl#findMethod(MethodID) calls, see bug 24720).

The implementation should be:
- if the cached stack frames are valid, return the top stack frame from this cache.
- otherwise, ask the vm for the top stack frame and cache the value.

title: Hover-help in wizards for long messages (1GKKS6N)
description:
It is possible (especially in other languages) to have a message exceed the 
space that is available for it in the wizard dialog.

In such cases we should provide hover-help to show the complete message.

title: [JFace] There is no way to set the DirectoryDialog's message in DirectoryFieldEditor
description:
There should be a setMessage(String) on DirectoryFieldEditor so that the 
DirectoryDialog created in DirectoryFieldEditor.getDirectory() can have its 
message set.  Currently to set the message on the DirectoryDialog, 
DirectoryFieldEditor.changePressed() has to be overridden.

title: [KeyBindings] registry: Accelerator key cannot be translated
description:
The "accelerator" attribute of "action" for ActionSet extention points has 
predefined values: "CTRL", "ALT", "SHIFT" and "COMMAND". However, in some 
languages, the key name may be translated, for example, in German, Ctrl may be 
translated to "Strg". 
If these kind of keys are to be translated by the contributor, they cannot be 
displayed, and the function is disabled.
I guess the predefine value should be more flexible to meet the globalization 
requirments.
Thanks.
